title: Complaint
description: One complaint on the account-file timeline, matching web/app/data-templates/complaint.json and the Complaint type in web/lib/account.ts. Blank template strings are placeholders and do not validate. Included by the account contract. POST /api/accounts checks each complaint against it.
x-standards: ISO 10002:2018 complaints handling (record, category, status, dates, resolution)
ITIL 4 incident priority (P1 most severe through P3)

x-frontend.openFilter: status Open is the open segment. Closed and Closed - reopened are the closed segment.

badgeTone.Closed - reopened: gray until the screen recognizes this phrase

x-notOnScreen: The complaints extract also has channel, region, source system, SLA, transfer, and bill-correction value. Those fields are not on complaint.json and are not part of this schema.
x-invariants: lastUpdatedDate is on or after createdDate.
When closedDate is a date, it is on or after createdDate.
Open complaints have closedDate null and an empty resolution.
Closed and Closed - reopened complaints have a closedDate and a resolution code.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Short line shown as the timeline title. ISO 10002 complaint summary. Not the category code and not the full narrative.
examples: Amount on the October bill is higher than expected

category.title: Category
category.description: ISO 10002 complaint category. Controlled list taken from the Northwind complaints extract so the category line on the timeline matches the source vocabulary.

description.title: Description
description.description: Customer narrative shown under the timeline title. Required for open and closed complaints.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Badge value on the timeline. High, Medium, and Low are the words the screen colors. Contact-centre codes map as P1 → High, P2 → Medium, P3 → Low (ITIL-style, P1 most severe).

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. ISO 10002 complaint status. Open has no close date. Closed and Closed - reopened both have a close date and a resolution; the third value is the extract status for a case that was reopened and then closed again.

assignedTo.title: Assignee
assignedTo.description: Agent shown on the complaint. ISO 10002 tracking of who is handling the complaint.

createdDate.title: Opened date
createdDate.description: Date the complaint was opened. ISO 8601 calendar date. Shown as Opened on the timeline.

lastUpdatedDate.title: Last updated
lastUpdatedDate.description: Date the complaint record last changed. On or after createdDate.

closedDate.title: Closed date
closedDate.description: Date the complaint was closed, or null while it is open. The template uses null, not an empty string.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: ISO 10002 resolution. Empty strings while the complaint is open. A code plus a customer-facing note once it is closed.

resolutionCode.title: Resolution code
resolutionCode.description: Empty string while open. Otherwise a closed-resolution code.

resolutionDescription.title: Resolution note
resolutionDescription.description: Empty string while open. Otherwise the note shown on the timeline, up to 2000 characters.

oneOf.description: Still being handled. closedDate is null and resolution is empty. Red badge, open filter.
Closed without a later reopen. Teal badge, closed filter.
Closed, and the case had been reopened before that close. Matches the extract status. Closed filter. The badge is gray until the screen lists this phrase.

ComplaintCategory.title: Complaint category
ComplaintCategory.description: Categories present on the Northwind complaints extract.

ClosedResolutionCode.title: Closed resolution code
ClosedResolutionCode.description: Stable code for a completed complaint. The source extract stores the matching sentence in resolution_action; put that sentence, or a more specific note, in resolutionDescription.

examples.reason: Amount on the October bill is higher than expected
examples.description: Customer disputes the October electricity charge and wants the estimated read checked.
